# performance of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:performanceOf`](gmeow-performanceOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/performanceOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a musical performance event to the creative work it performs — typically an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) interpreting a known version, or a [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) directly for an improvised or oral rendition with no mediating fixed [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md). Non-functional: a medley may perform several works, and a work may be performed by many events.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)
